title: Where your *money and time* should go

text: Most men spend money on dopamine and time on things they *won't remember.*

label: MONEY
head: Skills that pay forever
sub: A course, a coach, a certification. Paid once, earns for decades.

items.head: Calling your parents
items.sub: 10 minutes every Sunday. Nobody gets unlimited calls.

items.head: Building something
items.sub: A business, a garage project, a channel. Anything you own.

label: TIME
head: Being with people you love
sub: Nobody at 80 wishes they had scrolled more.

head: Where it actually goes
r: Protein, skills, a walk with a friend
